steps.objective: Discovery: locate the contract-tier request window definitions in billing-policy (exact path, symbols, line numbers) and the order-side checkout request-gate constant in orders-api (exact path, symbol, line), plus any other references to that constant.

Decide the consumption mechanism for orders-api to apply billing-policy's tier windows (package dependency, shared config, or generated copy), including tier-key mapping and fallback for a missing/unknown tier; confirm versioning/compat constraints.
Implement: replace the order-side constant in the checkout request gate with the billing-policy tier-window lookup; add/adjust unit tests covering representative tiers and edge cases.
Verify: run orders-api tests, grep for leftover references to the removed constant, and update docs-site pages if they document the gate or the constant.

questions.text: What are the exact file path, symbol names, and export mechanism of the contract-tier request windows in billing-policy?
What is the exact file path and line of the order-side checkout request-gate constant in orders-api, and is it referenced anywhere else (tests, other gates)?
How does orders-api currently consume or depend on billing-policy, and is there an approved mechanism or version-pinning contract for cross-repo reuse?

assumptions.text: Per the issue statement, billing-policy is the sole source of truth for the tier windows and needs no change; the modification is confined to orders-api's checkout request gate, with an optional docs-site update.
